hypothesis: Rescaling did not help. A quadratic length term and an interaction between special-token processing and truncation should better explain the ordinary-call costs while preserving the exceptional default-options state.

pcvs.name: default_options
pcvs.rationale: Separates the entry state containing the exceptional initialization cost.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else prompt['prompt'])
pcvs.name: prompt_chars
pcvs.rationale: Models tokenizer work that grows linearly with input length.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else prompt['prompt']) ** 2
pcvs.name: prompt_chars_squared
pcvs.rationale: Allows curvature in text-processing cost that the previous linear model could not explain.

pcvs.expression: int((tokenization_kwargs or {}).get('add_special_tokens', True) and 'truncate_prompt_tokens' not in (tokenization_kwargs or {}))
pcvs.name: special_tokens_without_truncation
pcvs.rationale: Captures the observed special-token cost increase before explicit truncation options are supplied.
